newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish union group against EMU link in short term.
newsitem.headline: Swedish union group against EMU link in short term.

text.p: A majority of unions linked to Swedish giant umbrella union organisation LO is against Swedish membership in Europe's Economic and Monetary Union (EMU) in the short term, the LO said on Monday.
"A majority of LO's unions estimate that the political and economic factors speaking against Swedish membership in the short term outweigh (the advantages)," LO said in a statement.
"The LO's top priority is full employment."
But in the longer term, Sweden's general political influence in the European Union (EU) will gain from EMU membership, LO said.
LO's statement came after the Swedish central bank on Friday recommended Sweden should join EMU from the start on January 1, 1999.
